ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Initiating a class income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. D — newton (N)

5. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. A — 100 °C

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

9. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. C — Ice melting to water

11. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
